summary.text: Debbie Meyers-Martin has represented the 38th District in the Illinois House since January 2019.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Meyers-Martin is a past village president and trustee of Olympia Fields, and the biography lists Meyers-Martin as president of the South Suburban Mayors and Managers Association.
Meyers-Martin holds a B.A. from the University of Illinois Chicago.
